# Agent Video Studio

> A front-end-only, local-storage video player and editor built for an *external* agent (Claude
> Desktop, ChatGPT, Codex, Claude in Chrome) to drive through registered tools -- there is no chat
> UI inside the app itself. Load a video (a bundled sample, a CORS-enabled URL, a YouTube link, or
> a local file), then seek, capture frames, detect scenes, segment and track objects, transcribe
> with search, cut clips, and export video/gif/notes, all with agent-driven timestamps. Every byte
> stays in the browser (OPFS + IndexedDB); every ML model downloads only when a tool call
> explicitly confirms it.

- [Agent skill (SKILL.md)](https://seidlr.github.io/agent-video-app/.well-known/agent-skills/agent-video-studio/SKILL.md):
  quick start, the tool response envelope, time-argument parsing, the job protocol,
  model-download gating, workflows, and safety notes. Discovery index at
  [/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json](https://seidlr.github.io/agent-video-app/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json);
  full bundle at [/skill.zip](https://seidlr.github.io/agent-video-app/skill.zip).
- [Tool reference (TOOLS.md)](https://seidlr.github.io/agent-video-app/.well-known/agent-skills/agent-video-studio/references/TOOLS.md):
  every registered tool's name, arguments, and an example call + result, generated from the live
  tool registry.
- [Per-host connection guide](https://seidlr.github.io/agent-video-app/.well-known/agent-skills/agent-video-studio/references/HOSTS.md):
  exact steps to connect from Chrome's native WebMCP, ChatGPT Desktop/Codex site tools, the MCP-B
  extension, or Claude in Chrome's scripting bridge.
- [Agent host status (docs/agents.md)](https://github.com/seidlr/agent-video-app/blob/main/docs/agents.md):
  the same host matrix with current verification status and dates, including the Claude Desktop
  MCP App and Codex CLI HTTP bus once they land.
